tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// dgon sde gsar 'debs sogs kyi tshe khyad chos sbyar bar 'os pa'i zur rgyan mal+li ka'i phreng ba bzhugs so// srid zhi'i mtha' la mi gnas bde chen gyi// don la dgyes par rol pa'i rdo rje dang*// tha dad min pa bla ma'i zhabs btud de// sa gzhi'i cho ga'i khyad par zur rgyan 'dri// 'dir dgon sde 'debs pa la sogs pa'i dus su kye rdo rje la brten pa'i sa chog thams cad mkhyen pa dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad pa ji lta ba bzhin las/ dkyil 'khor dang ma 'brel ba'i tshe sa'i lha mo'i mjug gi rgyal bar byas te dgos sde bya/ zhes pa lan gsum gyi rjes su/ bdag gis phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi bstan pa rin po che'i bshad sgrub phrin las dar zhing rgyas par bya ba'i phyir dang*/ 'jig rten gyi khams su dge legs rgya chen po 'byung bar bya ba'i phyir/ sa'i phyogs 'dir dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi tshogs chen po 'du ba'i gtsug lag khang dam pa dkon mchog gsum gyi rten dang*/ dgon sde chen po bskrun par 'tshal na/ sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing sogs gnang ba nod de/ sa yi lha mo sa de nyid la thim pa'i bar brjod/ gtor ma gnyis pa phyogs skyong la dkyus ltar phul ba'i rjes su/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten skyong ba chen po khyed rnams mchod sbyin gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ bdag gis phan bde'i 'byung gnas sogs nas 'tshal na/ zhes pa'i bar sa'i lha mo'i skabs dang 'dra ba'i rjes thogs su/ srung ma dam tshig can khyed rnams kyis/ gtsug lag brtsigs pa la sogs pa bstan pa rgyas pa'i bya ba mthar ma phyin gyi bar gyi bar chad thams cad zhi ba dang*/ mthun rkyen thams cad chos dang mthun par yid bzhin du 'grub pa'i phrin las stong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha zhes pas rang gnas su gshegs par bsam/

bar der gzhi bdag gi dkar gtor 'bul ba ni/ dkar gtor bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma 'dod dgu 'byung ba'i ye shes kyi bdud rtsir gyur par bsams la/ 'bru gsum brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas dzam+bu'i gling gi gzhi'i bdag po spyi dang*/ sgos su bod chen ljongs kyi gzhi bdag gtso bo khro zil khrom zhes pa lta bu skabs su gang bab sbyar/ bye brag tu sa phyogs 'di nyid kyi nyen skor khor yug kun tu gnyug mar gnas pa'i lha klu 'byung por gtogs pa'i sa bdag gzhi bdag yul bdag gi rigs su gtogs pa 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad oṃ ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥzhes pas bkug la/ oṃ sarba bhū mi pa ti lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra na maḥ sarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyis lan gsum bsngos la/ sa bdag dang gzhi bdag gnyan po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma rgya chen po 'di bzhes la/ bdag gis phan bde'i 'byung gnas sogs gong bzhin gyi 'tshal na zhes pa'i rjes su/ sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing ko lang ma mdzad par/ phan pa'i sems dang ldan par byos shig sarba bhū mi pa ti gats+tsha/ so sor rang gnas su gshegs shig ces brjod/ sngar gyi gtor ma'i lhag ma gsungs kyang*/ skabs 'dir bgegs gtor bshams pa la chab kyis bran te/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas bgegs rigs spyi dang*/ bye brag tu sa phyogs 'di khor yug tu 'khod cing 'dod pa'i gegs byed cing*/ mi 'dod pa bskyed pa'i bgegs rigs thams cad mchod sbyin gtor ma'i mgron du 'dir mchis par gyur cig oṃ ṭa ki hūm̐ dzaḥ zhes brjod pas gtor snod kyi mthar 'khod par bsams la/ oṃ sarba bigh+nān sogs lan gsum mam bdun gyis bsngo la/ sa phyogs 'dir ni slob dpon bdag /gtsug lag khang dang khang phran dag

/dkon mchog gsum gyi rten gsum tshogs// bzhengs kyis sogs dkyus ltar rol mo'i sgra drag tu bya'o// sa sbyang ba nas rak+ṣa lan gsum gyis brtan par bya ba'i bar dkyus ltar bya'o// de nas stang stabs kyi bkod pas sa bzung ba la phyogs bzhi'i gsol gdab yan dkyus bzhin byas/ de nas rang nyid he ru ka gsal ba'i snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ bla ma yi dam rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa'i tshogs bsam gyis mi khyab pa mdun gyi nam mkhar oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs te nam mkha'i ltos thams cad du khyab par bzhugs par bsams la/ de dag la pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ zhes pas gdan dbul/ spro na so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ gu ru bud+dha bo dhi satwa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ sogs nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod la/ sangs rgyas thams cad 'dus pa'i sku sogs kyis bla ma dang*/ thams cad dngos po'i rang bzhin sogs dang*/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ mkhyen brtse nus pa'i sogs kyis yi dam dang*/ ston pa bla med sogs kyis dkon mchog gsum dang*/ rdzu 'phrul stobs dang sogs kyis chos srung dang*/ nor gyi dbang phyug sogs kyis nor lha dang*/ bstod par 'os pa sogs kyis bstod la slar yang de dag la mos gus rtse gcig pas/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas sogs nas 'tshal na zhes pa'i bar gong ltar brjod pa'i mthar/ mkhyen brtse nus mthu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i bdag nyid chen po khyed rnams kyis sa'i phyogs 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rin po che de 'dzin gyi skyes bu dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi sde dpag tu med pa 'du ba'i rten dang brten par bcas pa bskal pa ji srid gnas kyi bar du dar zhing rgyas par 'byung bar byin gyis brlabs pa la dgongs pa rtse gcig tu gtod par gsol ba 'debs kyin mchi na ci gnang zhes brjod la/ de dag thams cad kyis thugs mthun par byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo// de nas rang he ru ka phyag gnyis pa'i nga rgyal gyis rnam lnga 'dod skor sngon du 'gro bas/

oṃ ma hā badz+ra sogs man chad 'dra bar byas la/ bgegs la bka' bsgo ba'i mjug khro bo'i sngags bzla zhing rol mo drag tu bya ba'i bar dkyus ltar byas la/ bsrung ba ni/ phur bu bcu'am ma 'byor na gcig cod paṇa dang*/ yungs dkar thum bu gdags pa mdun du 'dus byas la/ slar yang snying ga nas 'od zer phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ phyogs skyong bcu bkug ste/ phyogs mtshams steng 'og bcur 'khod par gyur zhes dang*/ rang gi snying ga nas rdo rje phur bu/ stod bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i rnam pa la/ lte ba man chad rdo rje rtse gcig pa'i dbyibs can bcu spros te/ phyogs skyong rnams kyi spyi gtsug nas phur bus btab par bsams la/ zhes pa gong 'og cung zad bsgyur te brjod na stabs bde/ gzhan dkyus na gsal ba ltar las/ phur bu dang*/ bgegs rnams kyi ro las 'od byung ba'i tshul gyis/ 'og thams cad rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ khor yug rdo rje'i rwa ba/ steng rdo rje'i gur/ phyi rol thams cad ye shes kyi me 'bar ba dang bcas pa'i srung ba'i 'khor lor gyur par bsams la/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan gsum brjod pa tsam gyis thus pas/ khro bo bcu'i srung 'khor ni 'dir bsgom mi dgos so// rjes ni bdag bskyed mjug gi bya ba skye mched sku gsung thugs kyi lha rnams gsal btab nas/ dge ba 'di yis nam mkha'i mtha' klas sogs kyi bsngo ba smon lam dang bkra shis ci rigs pa brjod par bya'o// dpal ldan kye yi rdo rje'i rnal 'byor brten// gtsug lag khang sogs brtsig pa'i nor 'dzin gzhi// brtag bslang sbyang gzung bsrung ba'i cho ga la// khyad chos sbyar du rung ba'i zur rgyan byas// rnam dkar legs byas mal+li ka yi phreng*// e waṃ yi ges mtshan bstan gzhal med khang*// mdzes byed rgyan du spud pas de yi tshul// bshad sgrub brtson pas sa steng brgyan par shog

/ces pa kye rdo rje'i rnal 'byor la brten pa'i sa chog ngor chen dkon mchog lhun grub pas mdzad par/ dgon sde gsar 'debs sogs kyi tshe khyad chos sbyar bar 'os pa'i zur rgyan mal+li ka'i phreng ba 'di ni/ dus 'khor bla ma kun dga' phun tshogs pas/ yid lhung lha rgyal du gtsug lag khang gi sa chog la dgos ched du/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen zhes bod pas lhun grub steng gi rgyal khab tu bris pa dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig/ // ༄༅// rten bzhengs rnams kyi gzungs 'bul mthar 'dod don gsol gdab dmigs bsal bstan 'gro'i dge legs 'phel byed ces bya ba bzhugs// ༄༅// bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum// bstan srung nor lha'i tshogs bcas kyi// thugs rje byin rlabs nus pa'i mthus// mngon 'dod 'bras bu g.yur zar mdzod// stobs bcu mnga' ba'i lung rtogs kyi// bstan pa'i snang byed sa skya pa// kun snying kun dga' bzang po bcas// brgyud par bcas pa'i lugs bzang gi /bshad sgrub 'chang ba'i bstan 'dzin rnams// zhabs pad brtan zhing phrin las kyi// snang ba dam pas sa steng gi /dkyil 'khor kun du khyab par mdzod// bstan pa'i rjes 'jug dge 'dun sde// li khri'i chu gter g.yo 'dra yis// phyogs kyi khor yug yongs khyab pa'i// chos spyod dge bcu lhur len mdzod// stobs 'byor dad ldan sbyin bdag gi /bsod nams mnga' thang rgyas pa'i mgron// sdom gsum ldan pa'i mchod yul rnams// bsnyen bkur mchod pas dgyes bskyed mdzod// yangs pa'i rgyal khams thams cad du// char chu thang zhod 'tsham pa yis// dbyar skyes lo legs 'bru tshogs kyi// dga' ston dgyes dgur rtsen par mdzod// 'gro ba'i bde skyid 'phrog byed pa'i// nad yams bkres rngabs 'thab rtsod sogs// mi mthun phyogs rnams nyi 'od kyis// mun pa'i dpung bzhin zhi bar mdzod// ces dang*/

yang de nyid tshig lhug pa ltar na/ byin rlabs kyi 'byung gnas rtsa brgyud kyi dpal ldan bla ma/ dngos grub kun gyi 'byung gnas yi dam lha tshogs/ skyabs gnas bslu ba med pa dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang*/ phrin las thams cad kyi 'byung gnas bstan srung nor lha'i tshogs thams cad dgongs su gsol/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi lung rtogs bstan pa'i snang byed chen po dpal sa skya pa kun dga' snying po yab sras brgyud par bcas pa'i lugs bzang dri ma med pa spyi dang*/ bye brag tu rgyal ba'i lung zin gyi skyes bu dam pa rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po pa yab sras brgyud par bcas pa'i mdo sngags bstan pa'i bshad sgrub dang*/ mkhas tshul gsum la dbang 'byor ba'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu gang dag byon dang 'byon 'gyur rnams kyi zhabs pad yun ring du brtan cing 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i phrin las kyi snang ba dam pas phyogs bral 'gro ba'i snying gi mun pa mtha' dag 'phrog par mdzod cig bstan pa'i bshad sgrub lhur len pa'i ngur smrig 'chang gi dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs chen pos sa steng kun tu khyab par brgyan cing chos spyod rnam bcu'i sgrub pa nyams len du bcas pa dar zhing rgyas par mdzod cig chos la dad pa'i sbyin bdag rgyal blon 'bangs 'khor bcas pa'i skye 'gro rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams dbang thang dpal 'byor rigs rgyud thams cad dbyar mtsho ltar 'phel zhing rgyas pa'i dga' ston 'dzad pa med pas dkon mchog la mchod pa dang*/ dge 'dun la bsnyen bkur gyi 'dod yon zad mi shes pa yid bzhin du 'jo bar mdzod cig de dag gi thugs rje dang byin rlabs la brten nas 'jig rten khams su char chu dus su 'bab pa dang*/ lo phyug rtag tu legs pa dang*/ chos dang srid pa'i dpal 'byor thams cad 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod cig nad yams mu ge dmag 'khrugs gsod gcod la sogs pa mi dge sdig pa'i spyod pa mi 'byung zhing byung ba thams cad nye bar zhi bar mdzod cig/

༈ //yang na/ phan bde'i 'byung gnas rgyal ba'i bstan pa rin po che gsal bar byed pa'i bstan 'dzin gyi skyes bu chen po dpal sa skya pa dang*/ rje btsun e waṃ pa chen po yab sras brgyud par bcas pa da ltar gang dag 'tsho gzhes su bzhugs pa 'byon 'gyur mkhas btsun gyi skyes bur bcas pa thams cad kyi sku tshe ring zhing 'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i phrin las dang 'gro don thams cad phyogs dus kun du dar zhing rgyas par mdzod cig bstan pa'i rjes su 'jug pa'i sdom pa sum ldan 'phags pa'i dge 'dun gyi tshogs chen pos sa steng khor yug kun tu khyab par brgyan cing chos spyod dge bcu'i sgrub pa nyams len du bcas pa 'phel zhing rgyas par mdzod cig chos la gus pa'i sbyin bdag rgyal blon 'bangs 'khor du bcas pa'i skye 'gro thams cad bde zhing lo legs dpal 'byor 'dod dgu phun sum tshogs pa la dbang 'byor zhing rten gsum 'di dag gis mtshon pa'i mchod rten dang sku gzugs rnams la mchod pa rgya chen po rgyun mi chad pa 'byung ba dang*/ dge 'dun gyi tshogs la bsnyen bkur gyi mchod pas dgyes par bskyed pa'i nus ldan du mdzod cig 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad nad yams bkres rngabs dmag 'khrug la sogs pa'i skal ba ngan pa thams cad mi 'byung bar mdzod cig/ //ces pa 'di'ang yid lhung lha rgyal srang du gtsug lag khang gi rten bzhengs rnams kyi gzungs 'bul mthar sbyor rgyur/ ban+de tshul khrims rin chen gyis 'phral la bris pa'o// //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o//
